answer: Make every agent stake reputation on a single identity vertex that only grows through verified work: new identities start behind a trellis of small, checked tasks, and each completed task adds a crystal-clear public record linking the work to that one vertex. Voting and payment rights unlock only as the record lengthens, so an attacker must pay the full cost of building a separate checked history for every fake identity, while honest agents reuse one history forever. Copies fail because the ledger sees the same work claimed twice.
